title: Senior QA Engineer — AI Products & Customer Implementations
description:

Helpware 's AI Platform team builds a portfolio of AI-native products for customer support and business operations, all running on a shared multi-tenant platform. The team also implements these products for individual clients with custom configurations, integrations, and SLAs.

We're looking for two Senior QA Engineers to own quality end-to-end - from pre-release testing of the products themselves to validating each customer's live implementation. The two hires will share this work across the portfolio, with each expected to flex between product testing and customer-facing implementation QA as priorities shift.

What you'll do

• Own test strategy for one or more products in the AI portfolio, from requirements review through release sign-off.

• Design, build, and maintain automated test suites covering API, UI, integration, and regression testing , integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

• Test multi-tenant platform behavior , including RBAC, tenant isolation, data access, and integrations with CRM, ticketing, telephony, and other third-party systems.

• Validate AI-agent behavior against functional requirements, including conversation flows, workflow automation, scoring and coaching logic, and structured-data extraction.

• Lead QA for customer implementations by validating client-specific configurations, connectors, knowledge bases, scoring rubrics, and workflow rules against requirements before go-live.

• Design and execute UAT plans together with client stakeholders and internal delivery and Customer Success teams.

• Perform exploratory and scenario-based testing against real customer workflows and monitor early-production behavior after launch.

• Distinguish between configuration issues, implementation defects, and product-level bugs, and ensure the right teams address them.

• Triage, document, and track defects; work closely with engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes.

• Maintain test plans, implementation checklists, and QA playbooks that can scale across a growing product portfolio and client base.

• Turn recurring implementation issues into automated regression coverage and continuously improve overall QA processes.

• Report on release readiness, product quality, and implementation risks to Product, Engineering, Delivery, and client-facing teams.

What we're looking for

•
5+ years of experience in software QA , including both product-level testing and customer-facing implementation or UAT activities.

• Strong hands-on experience with test automation , using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium , or similar.

• Solid experience with API testing using Postman, REST-assured , or comparable tools.

• Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, with the ability to create meaningful test scenarios from business and client requirements.

• Experience testing multi-tenant and role-based access systems , including data isolation and configuration-driven deployments.

• Ability to read and understand API and database schemas and work with engineers on root-cause analysis.

• Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into development and release processes.

• Comfortable working directly with external stakeholders during UAT and implementation validation.

• Strong understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, and release readiness.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for both technical and client-facing audiences.

Nice to have

• Experience testing AI/LLM-powered products , including accuracy evaluation, hallucination checks, prompt regression, RAG quality, or AI output validation.

• Experience in customer support, contact center, or BPO technology , including call QA, workforce management, agent-assist, or support automation platforms.

• Familiarity with AWS-based environments and cloud-based application testing.

• Experience with observability, logging, tracing

3362 - Associate Director, Analytics Modelling Services, UK

Role Summary and Impact

WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics is WPP’s data, analytics, product and technology division. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of analytical thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

Our UK Analytics team is one of our strongest globally, with 120 Analysts providing WPP Media’s clients with a full range of Analytics services that make tangible differences to our clients. There are three key teams within WPP Media Analytics UK:

• Modelling Services team - this is the largest part of the team and is responsible for all of our modelling work, including MMM, brand health modelling, RBA and other bespoke modelling solutions. Most of this team’s work is out of scope and sold in as paid for additional service to our clients.

• Applied Analytics - this part of the team conducts most other forms of day-to-day analytics for our clients, often working closely with the modelling team, but not undertaking the modelling themselves. Their responsibilities are broad and are centred around embedding analytics into our day-to-day media planning. Their responsibilities include helping clients with their measurement frameworks, using the modelling work done by our teams or external agencies, owning the test and learn roadmap, setting up and measuring media tests and adding the insight to our PCAs. This team is often included directly in our media planning fees, with many people fully FTE’d on clients. Their time is also sold on a project basis. Sitting within this team are our three Agency Leads, each one acting as the main point of contact between the agency client teams and all our UK Analytics team.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM.

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable.
Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique.

Votre mission :

• Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique.

• Manage the end-to-end administration of educational grants, fellowship grants, and investigator-sponsored research (ISR) programs, including application intake, review coordination, contract administration, budget tracking, reconciliation, and project closeout.

• Coordinate and support cross-functional governance committees, facilitating grant and research proposal reviews, documentation, communications, and decision-making processes.

• Partner with Medical Affairs leadership to track project progress, monitor risks, manage deliverables, and provide regular status updates and operational reporting to senior leadership.

• Lead routine presentations and progress reports to senior leadership team to guide strategic decision-making.

• Oversee contract management and agreements for physicians and clinical studies

• Manage departmental financial operations, including budget planning, forecasting, accruals, invoice processing, expense tracking, contract management, and vendor oversight.

• Support physician training, evaluation, certification, and proctoring programs by coordinating program requirements, documentation, scheduling, reimbursement processes, training materials, and learning management system updates.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, healthcare professionals, investigators, study teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners to ensure successful execution of Medical Affairs and Clinical Affairs initiatives.

• Provide operational support for a variety of Medical Affairs activities, including advisory boards, fellowship programs, research studies, publications, educational programs, controlled document management, adverse event reporting and other strategic projects
